Pre-orders & pop-ups

How R&R works

There’s no walk-in counter and no fixed hours — R&R cooks to order and pops up around Augusta. Here’s how to get a plate:

1

Place your pre-order

Email bostic.mikela@yahoo.com with what you’d like from the menu, and R&R confirms availability and your total.

2

Watch for pop-ups

Alongside pre-orders, R&R appears at pop-up events — the best way to try a bit of everything on the menu in one visit.

3

Pick up & dig in

Collect your order at 2004 Lumpkin Rd, Augusta, GA 30906 at the agreed time — hot, fresh, and made for you.

Catering

Feeding a crowd?
R&R caters.

Family gatherings, church events, office lunches, celebrations — bring the same soul-food spread to your table, in trays built for sharing.

  • Mains and sides from the regular menu, in catering portions
  • Specialty lemonades and banana pudding for the full spread
  • Book ahead by email — dates fill around pop-up days
